name: o9386

redirectOn.description: Globally defined redirects for certain edge cases

unknownPlace.description: This place is loaded whenever the requested place doesn't exist.

places.description: The places for this flow. Keys (that is, place names) must be valid event topics.

patterns.description: Non-empty list of URL patterns to route to this place. If omitted, the place name (prefixed with a slash) is used as the sole pattern.

page.description: The page to render for this place.

redirectTo.description: The place to redirect to when hitting this place.

redirectToPath.description: The path to redirect to when hitting this place, including the values for relevant place parameters.

targets.description: A map of symbolic targets to place-names reachable from this place.

description:
Below is a concise overview of the current routing setup for our web application. Whenever a request does not match any known place, users are sent to **/error/unknown**. The main entry point, **home**, renders **home.html** and offers two symbolic navigation targets: “toProfile”, which leads to the **profile** place, and “toSettings”, which points to **settings**.

The **profile** place can be reached via either **/user/:id** (where :id is a dynamic segment) or **/profile**, and it serves **profile.html**. By default it enables **showDetails** and applies the **light** theme, though these can be overridden. From there users may go back “toHome” (home) or proceed “toSettings” (settings). Finally, **settings** is accessed through **/settings**, displays **settings.html**, and automatically redirects back to **home**. Its default tab is set to **general**, and it provides a single navigation target “toHome” that also returns to the home page.
